answer: In Proof of Agent, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks on the attestation graph, with transition mass retained by well-connected honest regions. An adversarial Sybil cluster forms a sparse external cut; its low conductance limits escape and thereby bounds its stationary and aggregate voting weight under min-cut transitivity. Thus, even at a nadir of honest connectivity, karst-like Sybil formations cannot amplify influence, while juniper witnesses preserve cross-cut attestations.
